title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent Mode in Excel for desktop apps
description: Agent Mode is releasing to Copilot in Excel on Windows and Mac enabling users to build and edit workbooks with Copilot using multi-step workflows. Eligible licenses can now select which model to use, including both Open AI and Anthropic models.
